message.content: {"action":"sell_credit","units":3,"reason":"Devaluation at the round boundary will hit cash, so selling on credit preserves and multiplies revenue by 1.25"}
message.reasoning_content: Round 2 market. Selling now: prices from counter 2: 9,8,7,6... Selling 3 units gives 9+8+7=24. But cash gets devalued at round boundary 2+? "at the boundary of rounds 2+ cash=floor(cash/100)*62" — so round 2→3 boundary devalues. Better use sell_credit? sell_credit converts revenue to promissory, added at next round boundary, avoiding devaluation, and 1.25x. Yes, sell_credit 3 units: 24*1.25=30 promissory, paid next round without devaluation. Do that.
